New Hire Onboarding Guide
Welcome to MoaLogis.
This document provides a step-by-step guide for your first two weeks ▶

Please contact HR Manager Joonho Byun for any inquiries.
Seojin Um will assist you with setting up the development environment.
On your first day
Upon arrival, you will first obtain your access card at the information desk on the 1st floor.

The access card received should be registered by Jun-ho Manager.
The seat is next to the Dawn Team, and Ms. Eum-seojin will also sit in the same row.
Lunch will be eaten with the team members.

Day two
On day two, you will spend the entire day on-site.
For the unloading work, you will wear safety shoes and observe.
Do not approach or speak to a worker who is currently at work.

The experience report is submitted to the team leader for approval.
Once reviewed, it is forwarded to Jun-ho Manager.
First week

MoaLogis new hires will complete a task list called "Launchpad" during their first week.
Launchpad 1 involves logging into the wiki and joining the internal messaging system.
Company-wide announcements and casual conversations take place on the "Hearth" channel.
I'll leave a brief introduction on the "Hearth" channel.

Step 2 involves attending the "Pathfinder" training for the fleet allocation system.
Create a one-day fleet allocation plan as a Pathfinder.
Do not post the practice screen on the "Hearth" channel.

The report does not need to be lengthy.
Once all the tasks are completed, you will start working on real-world projects from the second week.
Your first practical task will be to conduct code reviews with Mr. Eumseojin.
The results of the code review will be shared on the "MoaLogis" team channel.

Please contact Jun-ho Manager if you have any questions.
Finally, leave a brief comment about your experience on the "Mokbul" channel.
